_comment: Hand-written additions merged by gen-tool-schemas.py on top of zenvi-core's schemas (agent_tools/schema.py
TOOL_SCHEMAS, the editor tool manifest docs/specs/desktop-editor-tools-manifest.json, the MCP extras) and the
backend's frontend-tool schemas (docs/specs/backend-frontend-tools.json). A description here wins over both.
Only descriptions, the real backend signature of tools the snapshot lacks, and default overrides live here;
names, types and enums come from the two sources.
web_extra_props: arguments only the web surfaces accept (hosts without a playhead or local paths, CLI aliases);
listed in docs/TOOLS.md under Divergences. Everything else matches the desktop's schemas.

common_props.timeline_clip_id: Timeline clip id (from list_clips_tool, get_timeline_state_tool or an earlier receipt).
common_props.clip_query: Describe the clip instead of passing an id: file name, subject, or words from its summary. Narrow it with track, occurrence or position_near.
common_props.track: Track: layer_number (preferred), track_id, the exact label, or ui_track counted from the bottom (1 = bottom).
common_props.occurrence: 1-based pick when the query matches the same source several times (0 = best match).
common_props.position_near: Timeline seconds; only clips that span this time match.
common_props.position_seconds: Timeline position in seconds (a timecode like 1:05 also works).
common_props.file_id: Media-bin file id (from list_files_tool or an import receipt).
common_props.modelId: Speech model id (on-device ASR hosts only).
common_props.engine: auto | apple | whisper (on-device ASR hosts only).

new_project_tool.description: Create a new empty project. save_first=true saves the current project where it is first.

path.description: Where to save the project (.zvn is appended when missing). Omit to save to the current location.

open_project_tool.description: Open a project from file_path. save_first=true saves the current project where it is before opening the other one.

watch_clip_tool.description: Play a clip in the editor preview: seek to a timeline clip (timeline_clip_id or query) and start playback. A media-bin file (file_id) or a media path (file_path) that is not on the timeline yet is added at the end of the bottom track first.

file_id.description: Media-bin file to play (added to the timeline when it is not there yet).

query.description: Describe the timeline clip to play.

file_path.description: Media path to import, place and play (hosts that can import local paths).

query.description: What should be on screen in the window.

start.description: Window start, source seconds (12, 12.5 or 0:12). Give start and end together, or neither to watch the best search match.

play_tool.description: Control preview playback: action play, pause, toggle (default, like the Space bar), stop (pause and return to the start), or step_forward / step_back by frames. Plays at normal speed only: fast_forward, rewind and other speeds are refused.

steps.description: Number of undo steps (1-20; words like 'two' work).

add_track_tool.description: Add empty tracks: on top (default, like the Add Track button), at the bottom, or above / below the track in relative_to. name names the track ('Music'); count adds several in one undo step ('<name> 1'..'<name> N' bottom to top). Track numbers count from the bottom; the new tracks are in createdTracks.

add_marker_tool.description: Add a timeline marker at position_seconds (default: the playhead), with a name and a colour tag.

scope.description: auto (default): a clip id/query deletes one placement, a bare track clears the track. clip / track force the branch.

include_transitions.description: Track scope only: also delete transitions on the track (default true).

ripple.description: One clip only: true closes the gap it leaves (later items on that track move left); default false leaves the gap.

detail.description: summary (default) or windows (also list speech windows in timeline seconds).

clip_id.description: Older name: one timeline clip id (added to timeline_clip_ids).

direction.description: Older argument: backward = reverse=true; forward changes nothing.

level_db.description: Target level in dB (0 = unchanged, negative = quieter). Give this or level.

level.description: Target linear gain 0.0-1.3. Give this or level_db.

volume.description: Alias for level (a string ending in 'dB' is read as level_db).

start_seconds.description: Window start, TIMELINE seconds. Omit start/end for the whole clip.

fade_ms.description: Ramp length at each window edge, milliseconds (default 150).

mode.description: replace (default) sets the level; scale multiplies the existing volume automation.

bed_clip_ids.description: Comma-separated music/SFX clip ids to duck (default: every bed overlapping speech).

bed_query.description: Describe the bed clip instead of passing ids.

bed_track.description: Only duck beds on this track.

speech_clip_ids.description: 'auto' (default: clips with transcript cues) or comma-separated speech clip ids.

duck_db.description: 'auto' (default: per bed, from measured levels) or dB of attenuation, e.g. -12.

release_ms.description: Ramp back up after speech, ms (default 400).

pad_before_ms.description: Start ducking this long before speech, ms (default 200).

pad_after_ms.description: Keep ducking this long after speech, ms (default 300).

boost_speech_db.description: Also set speech clips to this level in dB (default 0 = unchanged).

path.description: One file, folder or glob to import.

folder.description: A folder to import recursively (media files only).

skip_indexing.description: true to skip AI indexing after import (hosts with an indexer).

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait, seconds (min 30, default 1800).

show_dialog.description: true (default) opens the export dialog when the host has one; false renders directly to output_path.

output_path.description: Where to write the video (hosts pick a location when omitted).

key.description: width, height, fps_num, fps_den, start_frame, end_frame, sample_rate, channels, video_codec (vcodec), audio_codec (acodec), output_path (path), vformat (format), or any other export key.

value.description: New value (integers for the numeric keys).

split_file_add_clip_tool.description: Create a trimmed subclip of a media-bin file (source start_seconds..end_seconds) as a new media-bin entry, and place it on the timeline when position_seconds or track is given. Otherwise call add_clip_to_timeline_tool with the new file_id (no duration_seconds: the subclip is already trimmed).

query.description: What the kept moment shows (used to confirm the window when the host can watch frames).

track.description: Track (default: the selected track, else the bottom track).

position_seconds.description: Timeline position, seconds (default: right after the last clip on the track; 0 for audio).

duration_seconds.description: Keep window length, seconds. Alone on a full video nothing has looked at it is refused: name the window with start_seconds and end_seconds.

start_seconds.description: Source in-point relative to the file start, seconds. Alone it keeps the rest of the file.

end_seconds.description: Source out-point (keep window end). A duration_seconds that disagrees with it wins.

query.description: What the kept moment shows (used to confirm the window when the host can watch frames).

full_file.description: true to place the whole file (one continuous audio bed, or a whole video) without a watch.

look_for.description: "on_screen" when the query describes who or what is visible, "spoken" when it describes what is said; omit for both.

query.description: The moment to cut at, or an explicit source range like 'from 4 seconds to 10 seconds'.

start_seconds.description: Source seconds (12, 12.5 or 0:12). With end_seconds: keep that range (cuts before and after it). Alone: one cut at that time.

end_seconds.description: Range end, source seconds. Alone: one cut at that time.

beat_count.description: Number of windows to propose (1-8, default 4).

prefer_transparent.description: true (default) prefers transparent overlays over hero footage; false prefers opaque plates in gaps.

mode.description: overlay (transparent file on a high track), gap (opaque plate where the primary track is empty) or cut_in (opaque: ripple primary-track clips and cut it in).

layout_region.description: Region the graphic occupies (lower_third, corner_tr, corner_br, full_frame, mid_plate), recorded with the placement.

duration_seconds.description: Length on the timeline (default: the file's duration, 0.5-60 s).

fetch_motion_graphics_video_tool.description: Import rendered HyperFrames motion/demo segments into the project media bin. Pass segment_urls (the ordered per-segment URLs) or a single url/supabase_url. Imports skip indexing; label becomes the files' short summary. Then call place_motion_graphic_tool for each file_id.

prompt_hint.description: Optional style hint for the morph.

query.description: Part of a transition name, e.g. 'wipe' or 'circle'.

clip1_id.description: First (earlier) clip; the only clip for placement=start|end.

clip2_id.description: Second clip (placement=between): moved left to overlap clip1 by duration. Default: the next clip on clip1's track.

transition_name.description: Transition name from list_transitions_tool / search_transitions_tool, e.g. 'fade' or 'wipe left' (default fade).

placement.description: between (default: two clips), start (fade one clip in) or end (fade it out).

generate_tts_and_add_to_timeline_tool.description: Generate narration with AI text-to-speech and place it on the timeline at position_seconds (default: the playhead). Single tool for all voice-over requests: do not call separate generate/add TTS tools.

source.description: pexels or freesound (with link / preview_url from a stock search).

local_path.description: Import an already downloaded file instead.

start_seconds.description: Source in-point for the placement, seconds.

file_id.description: Indexed media-bin file to summarize again.

force.description: true to re-index a file that is already indexed.

add_effect_tool.description: Add a libopenshot effect (EffectInfo class_name such as Blur, Brightness, Saturation, ChromaKey) to one timeline clip, with its default parameters. When the clip already has that effect nothing changes, unless if_exists='add' stacks another copy. Returns the new effectId.

add_title_tool.description: Create a title / lower-third from a bundled SVG template with your text and place it on the timeline (default 5 s at 0 s).

file_name.description: File name for the generated SVG.

set_keyframes_tool.description: Animate one clip property (volume, alpha, location_x/y, scale_x/y, rotation) with keyframes. Each point gives one time inside the clip (frame = keyframe X; seconds from the clip's first visible frame; timeline_seconds; or source_seconds) and a value. interpolation: bezier (default), linear or constant, per point or for all; mode: replace (default), merge or replace_range. One undo step.

set_project_setting_tool.description: Change the project's frame rate, resolution and/or audio sample rate. Keyframes are rescaled on an fps change so animations keep their timing. No-op when the values already match.

fps.description: Frame rate as a number (23.976, 29.97 and 59.94 map to the NTSC fractions).

inspect_timeline_tool.description: See the composited timeline: JPEG frames (with a 0-1 coordinate grid) at 0-index project frames startFrame..endFrame, a single startFrame, a receipt's watchSuggested window (clipId + start + end), or overview=true for a spread across the timeline. Use it to verify an edit before claiming it is right.

inspect_media_tool.description: See frames from a media-bin file (fileId) between start and end source seconds, or overview=true for a spread across the whole file. Audio files return metadata only. Use it before describing footage; never guess from file names.

get_transcript_tool.description: Return the spoken dialogue of a timeline clip (clipId), a media-bin file (fileId), one track (trackIndex) or every clip, with timings in project frames. data.script holds the full dialogue.

transcribe_media_tool.description: Transcribe a media-bin file into the word-level transcript cache (hosts with on-device ASR).

remove_words_tool.description: Cut words out of a timeline clip and close the gaps (one undo step): pass matches (spoken tokens, case/punctuation insensitive), fillerPreset (um_uh or english_fillers) or wordIndices from get_transcript_tool. Needs word-level timings.

remove_silence_tool.description: Remove quiet gaps inside a timeline clip and close them (one undo step). Refuses when more than maxRemoveFraction of the clip would go.

maxRemoveFraction.description: Refuse if more than this fraction would be deleted (default 0.85).

add_captions_tool.description: Place timed dialogue captions (title clips) for a clip or the whole timeline from its transcript, or import an SRT/VTT file (srtPath). One undo step for all captions.

trackIndex.description: UI track index (1 = bottom) whose clips to caption.

export_captions_tool.description: Write the timeline's (or one clip's) dialogue as an SRT or VTT caption file.

trackIndex.description: UI track index (1 = bottom) whose clips to export.

detect_beats_tool.description: Detect music beats (times, frames, BPM) in a media-bin file or timeline clip (hosts with on-device beat tracking).

diarize_media_tool.description: Label speakers on a file's or clip's transcript words (hosts with on-device diarization).

search_media_local_tool.description: Search media-bin files with the on-device visual index (hosts that have one). Cloud index search is search_clips_tool.
